ucs.title: [LLM] Akira (PUNK SPIDER) pre-encryption exfil chain: WinRAR staging into RClone/FileZilla/WinSCP/MEGA egress
ucs.description: Detects Akira's signature double-extortion staging tradecraft — operators chunk victim data with WinRAR (often -hp password-protected, multi-volume -v archives) and exfiltrate the archives via RClone, FileZilla, WinSCP or MEGAsync to MEGA / cloud storage shortly before encryption. CISA AA24-109A, Sophos, and Arctic Wolf all flag this exact tool combination as Akira/Howling Scorpius/GOLD SAHARA pre-ransomware behavior.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstStage max(_time) as lastStage values(Processes.process) as archive_cmd values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("winrar.exe","rar.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe")) AND (Processes.process="* a *" OR Processes.process="* -hp*" OR Processes.process="* -v*" OR Processes.process="* -r *" OR Processes.process="* -m5*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | rename dest as host | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as exfilStart max(_time) as exfilEnd values(Processes.process) as exfil_cmd values(Processes.process_name) as exfil_tool from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("rclone.exe","filezilla.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","megasync.exe","mega.exe","megacmdshell.exe") by Processes.dest | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | rename dest as host] | where exfilStart >= firstStage AND exfilStart <= (lastStage + 14400) | join type=left host [| tstats summariesonly=t values(All_Traffic.dest) as remote_host from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_category="cloud_storage" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.mega.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.mega.io" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.userstorage.mega.co.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.backblazeb2.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*.pcloud.com" by All_Traffic.src | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Traffic")` | rename src as host] | table firstStage lastStage host user archive_cmd exfil_tool exfil_cmd remote_host | sort - firstStage
ucs.kql:
// Akira pre-encryption: WinRAR/7z staging followed by RClone/FileZilla/WinSCP/MEGA egress on same host within 4h
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let StagingWindow = 4h;
let Archiving = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("winrar.exe","rar.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe","winrar64.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (" a "," -hp"," -v"," -r "," -m5"," -ed "," -ibck ")    // archive verb + Akira-favored switches: password, split-volume, recurse, compression, exclude-empty, background
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project ArchiveTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ArchiveBinary = FileName, ArchiveCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
              ArchiveParent = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let Exfil = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ ("rclone.exe","filezilla.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","megasync.exe","mega.exe","megacmdshell.exe","pscp.exe")
       or (FileName =~ "powershell.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Invoke-WebRequest","Invoke-RestMethod") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega.nz","mega.io","transfer.sh"))
    | project ExfilTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, ExfilBinary = FileName,
              ExfilCmd = ProcessCommandLine, ExfilAccount = AccountName;
Archiving
| join kind=inner Exfil on DeviceId
| where ExfilTime between (ArchiveTime .. ArchiveTime + StagingWindow)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ExfilTime, ArchiveTime)
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("rclone.exe","filezilla.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","megasync.exe","mega.exe","megacmdshell.exe")
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where RemoteUrl has_any ("mega.nz","mega.io","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","backblazeb2.com","pcloud.com","transfer.sh","anonfiles","gofile.io","file.io")
       or RemotePort in (21, 22, 2121, 990, 989)
    | summarize ExfilDest = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25), ExfilIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25) by DeviceId
) on DeviceId
| project ArchiveTime, DeviceName, AccountName, ArchiveBinary, ArchiveCmd, ExfilTime, DelayMin, ExfilBinary, ExfilCmd, ExfilDest, ExfilIPs
| order by ArchiveTime desc

// Akira pre-encryption staging + exfil correlation in Sentinel via 4688 + SecurityEvent
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let StagingWindow = 4h;
let Archiving = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ImageName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ImageName in ("winrar.exe","rar.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe","winrar64.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any (" a "," -hp"," -v"," -r "," -m5"," -ed "," -ibck ")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project ArchiveTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
              ArchiveBinary = ImageName, ArchiveCmd = CommandLine;
let Exfil = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ImageName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ImageName in ("rclone.exe","filezilla.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com","megasync.exe","mega.exe","megacmdshell.exe","pscp.exe")
    | project ExfilTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, ExfilBinary = ImageName, ExfilCmd = CommandLine;
Archiving
| join kind=inner Exfil on Computer
| where ExfilTime between (ArchiveTime .. ArchiveTime + StagingWindow)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', ExfilTime, ArchiveTime)
| project ArchiveTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, ArchiveBinary, ArchiveCmd, ExfilTime, DelayMin, ExfilBinary, ExfilCmd
| order by ArchiveTime desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Akira BYOVD EDR-kill (Zemana/PowerTool driver) followed by akira_readme.txt / .akira encryption markers
ucs.description: Detects Akira's signature ransomware deployment chain: dropping a vulnerable signed driver (zam64.sys / zam.sys / powertool / gmer / kpcr) for Bring-Your-Own-Vulnerable-Driver EDR/AV termination, then writing the akira_readme.txt ransom note and .akira / .powerranges extension on the same host. Sophos, CrowdStrike (PUNK SPIDER), and Palo Alto Unit 42 (Howling Scorpius) all document this exact BYOVD-then-encrypt sequence as Akira's terminal kill-chain.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as driverDrop max(_time) as driverLast values(Filesystem.file_path) as driver_path values(Filesystem.process_name) as dropper from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name IN ("zam64.sys","zam.sys","powertool64.sys","powertool.sys","gmer.sys","gmer64.sys","kpcr.sys","truesight.sys","rentdrv2.sys")) OR (Filesystem.file_name="*.sys" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name("Filesystem")` | rename dest as host | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as ransomFirst values(Filesystem.file_name) as ransom_artifact values(Filesystem.file_path) as ransom_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("akira_readme.txt","fn.txt") OR Filesystem.file_name="*.akira" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.powerranges" by Filesystem.dest | `drop_dm_object_name("Filesystem")` | rename dest as host] | where ransomFirst >= driverDrop AND ransomFirst <= (driverLast + 43200) | table driverDrop ransomFirst host user dropper driver_path ransom_artifact ransom_path | sort - driverDrop
ucs.kql:
// Akira BYOVD driver drop + Zemana/PowerTool/GMER signed-vuln driver, followed by akira_readme.txt / .akira encryption marker on same host within 12h
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let DeployWindow = 12h;
let KnownBYOVD = dynamic(["zam64.sys","zam.sys","powertool64.sys","powertool.sys","gmer.sys","gmer64.sys","kpcr.sys","truesight.sys","rentdrv2.sys","aswarpot.sys","viragt64.sys"]);
let DriverDrop = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where (FileName in~ (KnownBYOVD))
         or (FileName endswith ".sys" and FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\"))
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("MsMpEng.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","msiexec.exe")
    | project DriverTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DriverName = FileName, DriverPath = FolderPath,
              Dropper = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DropperCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropperUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let ServiceCreate = DeviceRegistryEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where RegistryKey has @"\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\"
    | where RegistryValueName =~ "ImagePath"
    | where RegistryValueData has_any ("zam64","zam.sys","powertool","gmer","kpcr","truesight","rentdrv")
        or (RegistryValueData has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Temp\") and RegistryValueData endswith ".sys")
    | project SvcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, SvcKey = RegistryKey, SvcImage = RegistryValueData;
let RansomArtifact = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "akira_readme.txt"
         or FileName =~ "fn.txt"
         or FileName endswith ".akira"
         or FileName endswith ".powerranges"
    | summarize NoteFirst = min(Timestamp),
                EncryptedCount = countif(FileName endswith ".akira" or FileName endswith ".powerranges"),
                NoteWrites = countif(FileName =~ "akira_readme.txt" or FileName =~ "fn.txt"),
                NotePathSample = any(FolderPath)
      by DeviceId;
DriverDrop
| join kind=inner RansomArtifact on DeviceId
| where NoteFirst between (DriverTime .. DriverTime + DeployWindow)
| join kind=leftouter ServiceCreate on DeviceId
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', NoteFirst, DriverTime)
| project DriverTime, DeviceName, DriverName, DriverPath, Dropper, DropperCmd, DropperUser,
          SvcImage, NoteFirst, DelayMin, EncryptedCount, NoteWrites, NotePathSample
| order by DriverTime desc

// Akira BYOVD + ransom marker correlation in Sentinel
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let DeployWindow = 12h;
let KnownBYOVD = dynamic(["zam64.sys","zam.sys","powertool64.sys","powertool.sys","gmer.sys","gmer64.sys","kpcr.sys","truesight.sys","rentdrv2.sys","aswarpot.sys","viragt64.sys"]);
let DriverDrop = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)

    | where (TargetFileName in~ (KnownBYOVD))
         or (TargetFileName endswith ".sys" and TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Users\Public\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\Windows\Temp\", @"\PerfLogs\"))
    | where ActingProcessName !endswith @"\MsMpEng.exe"
         and ActingProcessName !endswith @"\TrustedInstaller.exe"
         and ActingProcessName !endswith @"\msiexec.exe"
    | project DriverTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              DriverName = TargetFileName, DriverPath = TargetFilePath,
              Dropper = ActingProcessName, DropperCmd = ActingProcessCommandLine,
              DropperUser = ActorUsername;
let RansomArtifact = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventType == "FileCreated"
    | where TargetFileName =~ "akira_readme.txt"
         or TargetFileName =~ "fn.txt"
         or TargetFileName endswith ".akira"
         or TargetFileName endswith ".powerranges"
    | summarize NoteFirst = min(TimeGenerated),
                EncryptedCount = countif(TargetFileName endswith ".akira" or TargetFileName endswith ".powerranges"),
                NoteWrites = countif(TargetFileName =~ "akira_readme.txt" or TargetFileName =~ "fn.txt")
      by DvcHostname;
DriverDrop
| join kind=inner RansomArtifact on DvcHostname
| where NoteFirst between (DriverTime .. DriverTime + DeployWindow)
| extend DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', NoteFirst, DriverTime)
| project DriverTime, DvcHostname, DriverName, DriverPath, Dropper, DropperCmd, DropperUser, NoteFirst, DelayMin, EncryptedCount, NoteWrites

ucs.rationale: The .akira / .powerranges extensions and akira_readme.txt note are deterministic Akira artifacts — no other ransomware family uses them. Pairing them with the specific signed-vulnerable drivers Akira affiliates are observed loading (zam64.sys = Zemana AntiMalware driver abused for kernel-mode EDR process termination, PowerTool64, GMER, kpcr) gives a 2-stage signature that is essentially unfakeable
